q: Which club was sent down to Serie B in 2006 over Calciopoli and came straight back up?
sub: Stripped of two titles, and they won Serie B at the first attempt.

q: Which club went bankrupt in 2004 and was refounded by the film producer Aurelio De Laurentiis?

q: Which club collapsed in 2015, restarted in the fourth tier and climbed back to Serie A in three seasons?

q: Which club went under in 2002 and spent a season playing as Florentia Viola?

q: Which club won promotion in 2005 and was then demoted to the third tier for fixing its last match?

q: Which club plays at the Penzo, a ground supporters can reach by boat?
